reason: Enables strict WebView CSP, enforces HTTPS GitHub release origins, and verifies SHA-256 digests with constant-time compare.
original_behavior: tauri.conf.json used csp=null and updater accepted arbitrary asset_url with byte-length checks only.
rust_behavior: STRICT_WEBVIEW_CSP blocks untrusted origins; updater rejects non-GitHub/HTTP URLs and SHA-256 mismatches.

reason: Replaces narrow blocklist in routes.rs with an explicit non-secret allowlist DTO.
original_behavior: /settings/get returned raw relayProfiles[*].authContents, vlmApiKey, Authorization headers, and weixinConnectToken.
rust_behavior: project_public_settings emits only non-secret metadata and boolean has* flags.

reason: Blocks /hooks/test-run, /hooks/file/write, /settings/set, and /delete from renderer extension calls and marks renderer scripts with main-world warnings.
original_behavior: Community renderer scripts showed zero warnings and shared main-world bridge access.
rust_behavior: Explicit route allowlist enforced and renderer scripts carry capability warning.

reason: Canonicalizes db_path against codex_home allowed DB list and verifies rollout_path containment under sessions/archived_sessions.
original_behavior: delete_local_session accepted unvalidated request.db_path and threads.rollout_path.
rust_behavior: Rejects any DB or rollout path outside approved codex_home directories.

reason: Eliminates fixed <file>.tmp write race condition and enforces owner-only permissions on Unix.
original_behavior: Used deterministic .tmp filename susceptible to concurrent overwrite/truncation.
rust_behavior: Uses per-PID/UUID temp filenames with sync_all before atomic rename.

reason: Prevents SQLITE_BUSY under WAL mode and avoids blocking GUI/async worker threads on synchronous I/O.
original_behavior: Used busy_timeout=0, BEGIN DEFERRED transactions, DB auto-creation on read, and sync Tauri commands.
rust_behavior: Sets 5s busy_timeout, SQLITE_OPEN_READ_ONLY without creating missing files, BEGIN IMMEDIATE writes, and spawn_blocking offloads.
